scope: New external cohort and its merger with unchanged published nativebaseline

findings.title: Five saved times certify sampled error only
findings.observation: Every record uses five common observation times; the maximum over these times is not a uniform-time bound or a physical componentwise relative-error bound.
findings.action: For changed dense/error-control code use independently prescribed dense interior samples, phase/amplitude metrics and physical scaled norms; retain ordinary rtol semantics.

findings.title: Large-vector native throughput trails Julia in latest diagnostic evidence
findings.observation: Julia/DOPRI common-cap time ratios are 0.2341/0.1753 at4096 and0.2052/0.1886 at16384. The native facade and kernel both poison/check RHS output. Cross-cohort differences do not identify the bottleneck causally.
findings.action: Remove demonstrably redundant vector passes while preserving direct-kernel and facade malformed-callback contracts; paired same-host source/binary-pinned benchmark before/after and counters/state parity. Profile fused unit-stride stage combinations next.

findings.title: Rapid oscillator does not meet the registered tight sampled-error cap
findings.observation: DOPRI best sampled normalized error1.971506e-8 exceeds1e-8 on registered grid. Diffsol5.873e-9 andJulia1.754e-9 meet it. This is a finite-grid result, not an impossibility theorem forDOPRI.
findings.action: Separate phase andamplitude error andsample interior trajectory; preregister lower tolerances/longer intervals only asnewexperiment, then assess estimator/controller or higher-order explicit method at common achieved-error targets.

findings.title: Timing evidence remains exploratory
findings.observation: Cross-cohort load varied; three repeats are not a statistical speedup estimate; native outputs land steps while external outputs interpolate; Julia prepares one same-request solve outside solver timer and all adapters include setup/output costs. These limitations are correctly disclosed.
findings.action: Paired randomized interleaving, fixed affinity/thread settings, more repeats, identical output contract and fullsetup costs; separately report process/JIT/startup latency. Do not retroactively revise old comparisons.

findings.title: Large vector is an eight-rate repeated diagonal fixture
findings.observation: State dimension alone does not exercise coupled sparse/FVM physics, limiter nonsmoothness, nonlinear stiffness or conservation.
findings.action: Nextbroadcampaign add semidiscrete advection/diffusion manufacturedsolutions withconservation/positivity andspatial-refinement separation, plus couplednonlinear clients; retaindiagonalfixture asmemorybaseline.

findings.title: Unqualified production use lacks dispatcher and broad client contracts
findings.observation: DOPRI explicitly selected forward identitymass solver; mass/events/dense output refused; noautomatic stiffness switch. Strongstiffcontrol cost reversals persist.
findings.action: Keep optin supportcontract; scopedproductionreadiness needscorrectfailure/restart/output/physicalnorm behavior plus clientspecific benchmarks. An optin boundeddispatcher canbe developed separately; do notinferstiffness fromabsenceofJacobian.
